# Tuya TV Viewer v0.8.0: Annex B, AVCC, and RTP video

Tuya Smart streaming prototype for Android TV. Attempts to read H.264/H.265 Annex B frames, AVCC, and fragmented RTP, then use the Android hardware decoder. Reports the first decoded frame when available, along with packet statistics and checks. Cameras that do not answer SDP remain incompatible with the implemented negotiation. No video frame, key, token, or personal identifier is stored in GitHub logs. Same application ID as v0.7; its debug signature was not stable, so uninstalling the previous APK may be required. Android 7+ / ARM64.
